'''Jess''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]] at the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She often flirted with the crime lord's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], though she wanted to leave the Hutt's service. Jess was present in the palace in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] when the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] arrived at the palace to deliver a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] message from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. She later witnessed the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band's]] performance of "[[Jedi Rocks/Legends|Jedi Rocks]]" and the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] dancer [[Oola/Legends|Oola's]] subsequent [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's rancor]]. 

Right after Oola's death, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], disguised as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], arrived with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and negotiated with Jabba over the [[Currency/Legends|price]] of him. When [[Local day/Legends|night]] fell that day, Jess slept on [[Jabba the Hutt's dais/Legends|Jabba's dais]] as Organa made her way through the throne room to free Solo from [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. The next morning, Jess rested with the hunter [[J'Quille/Legends|J'Quille]] when Skywalker arrived to free his friends from Jabba. She then watched the Jedi and his friends be sentenced to death at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]].

==Biography==
===A dancing girl with dreams===
[[File:JessAndBib-SWRPG2E.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jess often flirted with Bib Fortuna.]]
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Jess<ref name="databank" /> was a dancing girl<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> and a popular<ref name="databank" /> [[Musician/Legends|singer]] at the<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]]<ref name="CSWE" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> She often flirted with<ref name="databank" /> Jabba's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]],<ref name="databank" /> and accompanied<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. She dreamt of leaving Jabba's service<ref name="CSWE" /> and hoped to leave the palace she frequented and join a band.<ref name="databank" /> 

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="rotj" /> in 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Jess was present in<ref name="rotj" /> the throne room<ref name="Complete Locations" /> of Jabba's palace, leaning against a column in one of the room's<ref name="rotj" /> cubicles<ref name="Complete Locations" /> when the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] arrived to display a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to Jabba. Jess watched the message that displayed Skywalker bargaining for the release of his friend [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was kept encased in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] in the throne room, though Jabba laughed at the message and rejected it.<ref name="rotj" />

===Spending time with the majordomo===
[[File:Oola defies Jabba.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Jess and Bib Fortuna (right) watched Oola's refusal to sit with Jabba.]]
Shortly after the droids' arrival, Jess was once again present in the throne room during a performance of "[[Jedi Rocks/Legends|Jedi Rocks]]" by the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]]. Jess and Fortuna sat together in a cubicle next to band member<ref name="rotj" /> [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] as Jabba ordered his [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] dancer [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] to repeat her performance. After refusing to sit with the Hutt, Oola was dropped into to the<ref name="JN">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] pit<ref name="Complete Locations" /> below the throne room. Fortuna led her over to the<ref name="rotj" /> viewing grille<ref name="Complete Locations" /> and the two watched as she was eaten by [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's rancor]].<ref name="rotj" />

While this occurred,<ref name="rotj" /> the sound of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire<ref name="JN" /> entered the throne room, which drew the attention of its occupants. Jess and others moved closer to the throne room entrance, but she was led back<ref name="rotj" /> to the cubicle<ref name="Complete Locations" /> by Fortuna after [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], disguised as the bounty hunter [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], and the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] entered. Organa and Jabba negotiated over the [[Currency/Legends|price]] of the Wookiee<ref name="rotj" /> while Jess and Fortuna looked on.<ref name="Complete Locations" /> During the talk, the Princess pulled out a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], which led to panic in the throne room, but also an agreement in the negotiation. Chewbacca was taken down to the palace dungeons and the throne room party resumed.<ref name="rotj" />

When [[Local day/Legends|night]] fell on Tatooine, Jess slept on [[Jabba the Hutt's dais/Legends|Jabba's dais]] while Fortuna and Jabba were awake in the Hutt's<ref name="rotj" /> private elevator.<ref name="Complete Locations" /> Organa made her way through the throne room to free Solo from carbonite though after she did, Jabba and the members of his [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]] revealed themselves and captured both of them.<ref name="rotj" /> In the early morning of the next day,<ref name="Complete Locations" /> Jess rested in the [[Limb/Legends|arms]] of<ref name="rotj" /> the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] hunter [[J'Quille/Legends|J'Quille]]<ref name="CharEnc">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> in one of the throne room cubicles when Luke Skywalker entered after being let in by a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricked]] Fortuna. The Jedi petitioned for the release of his friends and ended up threatening the Hutt with a stolen [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], causing him&mdash;and the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guard [[Jubnuk/Legends|Jubnuk]]<ref name="Pop-Up Palace">''[[Jabba's Palace Pop-up Book]]''</ref>&mdash;to be dropped into the rancor pit. After Skywalker killed the rancor, he and his allies were sentenced to death at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] in Tatooine's [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. While the Jedi was sentenced, Jess stood near J'Quille and did not leave the throne room with<ref name="rotj" /> him<ref name="CharEnc" /> when the sentencing was over.<ref name="rotj" />

==Personality and traits==
Jess, a popular individual,<ref name="databank" /> had a way of captivating her entire audience<ref name="CSWE" /> and those around her.<ref name="databank" /> Wanting to join a band and leave Jabba's palace,<ref name="databank" /> Jess also dreamed of leaving his service.<ref name="CSWE" /> The singer had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin<ref name="rotj" /> and platinum blonde [[Hair/Legends|hair]] with a blue stripe at the front.<ref name="databank" /> She was considered beautiful and Bib Fortuna appeared to be romantically interested in her during his last days as majordomo.<ref name="KissAWookiee">{{SW|url=news/id-just-as-soon-kiss-a-wookiee-star-wars-romances|text=I'd Just as Soon Kiss a Wookiee: ''Star Wars'' Romances|nolive=1}}</ref> She kept a flirtatious [[Eye/Legends|eye]] on him during the [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|Rescue of Han Solo]].<ref name="Ask Lobot" />

==Equipment==
During her [[Time/Legends|time]] in Jabba's palace<ref name="rotj" /> in 4 ABY,<ref name="NEC" /> Jess wore a bronze-colored [[Clothing/Legends|brassiere]] that was asymmetrical, blue pants with a bronze waist piece, and sandals.<ref name="rotj" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|There's a scantily clad girl with platinum blonde hair, bare midriff, and flirtatious eye on Bib Fortuna. Her name is Jess.|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|<ref name="Ask Lobot">{{InsiderCite|66|Ask Lobot}}</ref>}}
[[File:ROTJ_polaroid_Jess.jpg||thumb|left|200px|Amanda Noar on the set of ''Return of the Jedi'']]
Jess first appeared as a briefly glimpsed background character in {{Film|VI}} played by English dancer and actress [[Amanda Noar]].<ref name="blog">{{SW|url=news/return-of-the-jedi-creature-history-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=''Return of the Jedi'' Creature History with Pablo Hidalgo|nolive=1}}</ref> The character of Jess is more clearly visible in [[1983]]'s ''[["Lapti Nek": The Music Video from Jabba's Palace]]'', and additionally appears in ''[[Return of the Ewok]]'', a mockumentary created by actor [[Warwick Davis]] during his time on the set of ''Return of the Jedi'', that blends elements of the movie with the real world. In the short film, Davis, dressed as [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]], wanders onto the set of Jabba's Palace while searching for the [[Forest/Legends|Forest]] [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. He finds [[Laudica]] and Jess rehearsing a choreographed dance to [[Lapti Nek/Legends|Lapti Nek]], a song being performed by the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]].<ref name="Return of the Ewok">''[[Return of the Ewok]]''</ref>

Bib Fortuna actor [[Michael Carter]], via an interview on [[TheForce.net]], has alluded to several cut scenes from ''Return of the Jedi'' that involved Jess and [[Salacious B. Crumb/Legends|Salacious B. Crumb]].<ref name="TFNinterview">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/jedicouncil/interview/mcarter.asp|text=Interviews - Cellblock 1138 - Michael Carter|work=[[TheForce.net]] - Jedi Council|date=2013-02-17|archivedate=20161010075122}}</ref> Some of these scenes appear in ''"Lapti Nek": The Music Video from Jabba's Palace''.
